title: The Mermaid and the Rainbow Shell

pages.title: A colour in the sand
pages.caption: Mira spots a rainbow shell.
pages.speech: Mira the mermaid spotted a shell with rainbow colours. It rested in the sand beside a swaying sea plant. What a beautiful little home, she said.
pages.art: Mermaid Mira with copper skin dark curly hair turquoise tail coral top finds pearly rainbow spiral shell on sandy seabed.

pages.title: Look before you lift
pages.caption: Is someone living inside?
pages.speech: Mira looked closely before touching it. A tiny claw peeked out. Someone was already living inside! The shell belonged to a little hermit crab.
pages.art: Same mermaid carefully observes small hermit crab claw peeking from rainbow spiral shell, gentle clear underwater scene.

pages.title: A wobbly path
pages.caption: The crab is trying to reach a rock.
pages.speech: The little crab wanted to reach a sheltered rock. But a loose piece of litter lay across the sand. Mira knew litter did not belong in the sea.
pages.art: Small hermit crab in rainbow shell faces discarded plain plastic loop on sand; mermaid notices, safe no entanglement.

pages.title: Clear the way
pages.caption: Mira puts the litter in her basket.
pages.speech: Mira carefully lifted the loose litter into her basket. She would take it to the shore for proper disposal. Now the sandy path was clear.
pages.art: Mermaid places loose plastic loop into woven collection basket, crab path now clear, underwater plants.

pages.title: Travel together
pages.caption: Slow is a good speed for a small crab.
pages.speech: Mira swam beside the crab. She did not hurry him or carry his shell away. Slow was a good speed for such small legs.
pages.art: Mermaid swims slowly beside tiny hermit crab walking in rainbow shell toward sheltered rock.

pages.title: A sheltered home
pages.caption: A calm place beside the rock.
pages.speech: At last, the crab reached a calm spot beside the rock. Little fish drifted past. Mira waved gently and gave her new neighbour plenty of room.
pages.art: Rainbow-shell crab sheltered beside smooth rock with small fish, mermaid waves at respectful distance.

pages.title: The best treasure
pages.caption: A living sea to care for.
pages.speech: Mira left the rainbow shell with its owner. The best treasure was a living sea to care for, full of creatures with homes of their own.
pages.art: Mermaid admires thriving reef from distance, hermit crab in shell at rock, diverse gentle fish and sea plants.

pages.title: What will you notice?
pages.caption: Look closely. Care gently.
pages.speech: Mira swam home with her basket of litter. Next time she saw a pretty shell, she would look closely first. What might you notice by the sea?
pages.art: Mermaid at shallow shore brings basket of litter to collection point, clean beach, shell crab visible safely below water.

notes: Original story and illustrations; all family profiles can read it.
